sentences.l2: 这个机器人可以自己做事。
sentences.l1: This robot can do things by itself.
It can work on a computer.

sentences.l2: 它可以帮助人写东西，也能学习新东西。
sentences.l1: It can help people write things, and it can also learn new things.

sentences.l2: 小明把机器人的程序放在自己的电脑里。
sentences.l1: Xiao Ming put the robot's program in his own computer.

sentences.l2: 这样，别人就不能控制它了。
sentences.l1: This way, other people can't control it anymore.

sentences.l2: 很多人喜欢这样的机器人。
sentences.l1: Many people like this kind of robot.
They also hope to have one.
This kind of robot is called "Open-Source Claw".
It is very free, and anyone can use it.

sentences.l2: 2026年，很多人可能都会用这种机器人。
sentences.l1: In 2026, many people may all use this kind of robot.

sentences.l2: 因为它可以保护隐私，又能帮助人完成很多任务。
sentences.l1: Because it can protect privacy and can also help people complete many tasks.

sentences.l2: 小明很高兴，因为他可以自己管好机器人。
sentences.l1: Xiao Ming is very happy, because he can manage the robot by himself.
